About SDS011 Native General Hardware & Setup Licenses
Native Android app for mobile particulate matter measurement using the SDS011 laser dust sensor over Bluetooth Classic (HC-05/HC-06). Disclaimer The displayed measurement values are for informational purposes only. The developer assumes no liability for the accuracy of the data or damages caused by malfunctions.
Sensor & Bluetooth Wiring The SDS011 particulate matter sensor is connected to the Android smartphone via a serial Bluetooth module (HC-05 or HC-06):\n\n• SDS011 TX ➔ HC-06 RX\n• SDS011 RX ➔ HC-06 TX\n• SDS011 5V ➔ 5V Power Supply (Powerbank / USB)\n• SDS011 GND ➔ GND\n\nBefore connecting for the first time, pair the HC-05/HC-06 module once in Android Bluetooth settings (pairing PIN is usually 1234 or 0000).
